title: Om
desc: After thwarting the enemy's plans to kill his father Harishchandra, Arjun learns a shocking truth that turns his life upside-down.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Bhadrakaali
desc: A man who seeks justice opposes a tyrannical dominion to inspire widespread dissent among the oppressed masses. Consequently, the brave man triggers immediate retaliation.

title: The Warrior
desc: After enduring a ruthless gangster's cruelty, a former doctor transforms into a police officer and returns to his city on a quest for justice.

title: Balagam
desc: A young man in severe debt believes that the only way to pay it off is through the dowry from his impending marriage. However, the death of his grandfather puts his plan on hold.

title: Mass
desc: A man falls in love with the daughter of a dreaded gangster. When the gangster kills his friend and tries to separate the two lovers, the heartbroken lover sets out to exact revenge against him.

title: Raghavendra
desc: After a deadly gangster kills his lover, Raghava, a strong man who fights for justice, loses interest in life. However, when his parents motivate him, he decides to fight back.

title: Dhairyam
desc: Batchmates Seenu and Mallika fall in love in spite of their different economic backgrounds. However, Mallika's father objects to the relationship and gets Seenu arrested on false charges.

title: Parking
desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

title: Gully Rowdy
desc: A young man tries to find a balance between his love interest and friends. Meanwhile, his friends convince him to stay rowdy.

title: Fidaa
desc: Varun, an NRI medical student, and Bhanu, a vivacious, young woman, fall in love with each other. However, they face many personal differences that create complications in their relationship.

title: Policeodu
desc: A police officer goes into hiding to bring up his daughter in a safe environment. However, after her life is threatened by deadly gangsters, he must face his past to protect his daughter.

title: Nuvve Nuvve
desc: Vishwanath is a millionaire who will do anything for his daughter, Anjali. When she falls in love with Rishi, a middle-class boy, he tries everything in his power to end the affair.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.
